comparison.objective: Open a locker supporting a leaning case and remove the case upright without dropping it; candidate performs screen separation.
comparison.physical_skill: Door/case coordination and upright transport of a precarious load versus screen grasping, pouring and granular agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Case never tips beyond 45° or drops, then stands released on the mat; candidate grades recovered media mass, retained washers and immutable loss.
comparison.reason: Precarious rigid-object extraction is physically different from aperture-mediated sifting.
